cover: Homeless ragpicker set on fire, dies

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.head: Drone strike on a city district
bullets: The RSF-led Tasis alliance blames an army drone.
Neither account has been independently verified.
Army-linked sources say it hit RSF sites.

stories.label: World · Right upheld
stories.head: Myanmar committed genocide, court rules
bullets: The case covers the Rohingya crackdown of 2017.
About 10,000 Rohingya were killed, the court said.
Myanmar says it answered attacks on police posts.

stories.label: India · Life & safety
stories.head: Ragpicker tied up and set alight
bullets: Syed Haji, about 45, lived on the streets.
He died in hospital the same evening, 18 Nov.
Police filed a murder case; no arrests reported.

stories.label: India · Housing
stories.head: Evicted, then cleared from the riverbed
bullets: They were evicted from grazing land on 13 Nov.
Riverbed shelters were removed on 19 Nov.
Officials say 25–30 families could take belongings.
